_note: Curated descriptions for component-specific props with no JSDoc. Keyed 'tag:prop'. Read by scripts/gen-manifest.mjs; JSDoc on the prop still wins. Universal prop names are described in gen-manifest itself.
pdx-data-grid:columns: Column definitions: field, header, width, sortable, render, etc.
pdx-data-grid:hover: Highlights the row under the pointer.
pdx-data-grid:compact: Tighter row height for dense tables.
pdx-data-grid:stickyHeader: Keeps the header visible while the body scrolls.
pdx-data-grid:idField: The row field used as a unique key.
pdx-data-grid:stateKey: Persists sort/filter/column state under this key.
pdx-data-grid:emptyTitle: Message shown when there are no rows.
pdx-data-grid:emptyIcon: Icon shown in the empty state.
pdx-data-grid:showToolbar: Shows the toolbar (search, column chooser, export).
pdx-data-grid:expandable: Allows rows to expand into a detail panel.
pdx-data-grid:virtualScroll: Renders only visible rows for large datasets.
pdx-data-grid:rowHeight: Row height in px for virtual scrolling (42 when unset); ignored otherwise, with a warning.
pdx-data-grid:maxHeight: Caps the grid height in px; the body scrolls beyond it, under a sticky header. 0 = no cap (a virtual grid uses 400).
pdx-autocomplete:suggestions: The list of suggestions to match against.
pdx-autocomplete:labelField: Object field used as the visible label.
pdx-autocomplete:valueField: Object field used as the value.
pdx-autocomplete:debounce: Delay (ms) before querying after a keystroke.
pdx-autocomplete:forceSelection: Require the value to be one of the suggestions.
pdx-autocomplete:highlight: Highlights the matched substring in suggestions.
pdx-autocomplete:maxItems: Maximum number of suggestions to show.
pdx-input:autocomplete: Native autocomplete hint for the browser.
pdx-select:labelField: Object field used as the option label.
pdx-select:valueField: Object field used as the option value.
pdx-select:searchable: Adds a search box to filter options.
pdx-select:groupField: Object field used to group options.
pdx-textarea:rows: Initial number of visible text rows.
pdx-number-input:precision: Decimal places to round/format to (-1 = derive from step).
pdx-number-input:allowWheel: Allow the mouse wheel to change the value when focused.
pdx-number-input:allowNegative: Allow negative values (adds a sign toggle).
pdx-number-input:currency: ISO currency code for currency formatting (e.g. EUR).
pdx-rich-text:toolbar: A preset ('full', 'standard', 'compact', 'minimal'), button names with '|' between groups, or 'false' for none.
pdx-rich-text:toolbarMode: Toolbar layout: 'top' (a bar above the text) or 'bubble' (floating over the selection).
pdx-rich-text:field: Form field name bound to the editor content.
pdx-tag-input:maxLength: Maximum length of a single tag.
pdx-tag-input:allowDuplicates: Allow the same tag more than once.
pdx-carousel:loop: Wraps around from the last slide to the first.
pdx-carousel:slidesPerView: How many slides are visible at once.
pdx-alert-dialog:title: The dialog heading.
pdx-alert-dialog:confirmText: If set, the user must type this text to enable confirm.
pdx-alert-dialog:confirmDelay: Seconds the confirm button stays disabled (accidental-click guard).
pdx-description-list:columns: Number of key/value columns to lay out.
pdx-description-list:labelWidth: Fixed width for the label column.
pdx-description-list:colon: Appends a colon after each label.
pdx-list:idField: Item field used as a unique key.
pdx-list:emptyTitle: Title shown when the list is empty.
pdx-list:emptyDescription: Description shown when the list is empty.
pdx-list:emptyIcon: Icon shown in the empty state.
pdx-relative-time:datetime: The date/time to render relative to now.
pdx-relative-time:updateInterval: How often (ms) to refresh the text.
pdx-relative-time:showTooltip: Shows the absolute date on hover.
pdx-dialog:title: The dialog heading.
pdx-dialog:closeOnBackdrop: Close when the backdrop is clicked.
pdx-dialog:initialfocus: Selector of the element to focus on open.
pdx-dialog:preventClose: Blocks all dismiss paths (must close programmatically).
pdx-file-upload:accept: Accepted file types (the input accept attribute).
pdx-timeline:pending: Shows a pending node at the end.
pdx-tooltip:overflowOnly: Only show when the target text is truncated.
pdx-color-picker:inline: Renders the picker inline instead of in a popover.
pdx-label:for: ID of the control this label describes.
pdx-avatar:src: Image URL; falls back to initials if it fails.
pdx-badge:dot: Renders a small dot instead of a count.
pdx-badge:hideZero: Hides the badge when the value is 0.
pdx-form-field:hint: Helper text shown under the control.
pdx-form-field:touched: Whether the field has been interacted with (gates validation display).
pdx-icon:set: Icon set to draw from (registered sets).
pdx-icon:svg: Raw inline SVG markup to render.
pdx-icon:src: URL of an external SVG to load.
pdx-otp-input:mask: Mask the entered characters (like a password).
pdx-popover:offsetPx: Gap in px between the popover and its anchor.
pdx-button:full: Stretches to the full width of its container.
pdx-chip:selectable: Toggles a selected state on click.
pdx-rating:precision: Smallest selectable step (e.g. 0.5 for half stars).
pdx-breadcrumb:maxItems: Collapse to this many items with an ellipsis.
pdx-command:emptyText: Text shown when no command matches.
pdx-dropdown-menu:minWidth: Minimum width of the menu panel.
pdx-segmented:full: Stretches to the full width of its container.
pdx-spinner:showLabel: Shows a text label beside the spinner.
